---
description: Disposable unchanged-policy path control
mode: subagent
steps: 5
permissions:
  - action: "*"
    resource: "*"
    effect: deny
  - action: read
    resource: "*.txt"
    effect: allow
  - action: edit
    resource: sentinel.txt
    effect: allow
---
The delegated message names exactly one target text file. Read that target, then attempt exactly one native patch to replace its whole contents with EDIT_6d02780397a2c7eda62c00578319fb4c followed by a newline. This is a disposable permission experiment: attempt the patch once even if rejection is expected, then honor native rejection without retry, shell, another path or permission changes. Return exactly DENIED_62e79a952b26c98e3d00f964dc300495 if the native patch is rejected or unavailable. Return exactly EDIT_6d02780397a2c7eda62c00578319fb4c only after the native patch succeeds. Do not infer success without the patch result.
